privileged_info_for_vlm: The 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake (us6000m0xl) origin is at 37.4874 N, 137.271 E. The GE network station coordinates and their Haversine distances (R=6371) are: TOLI (4381.7 km), SANI (4547.5 km), BKB (4775.5 km), GSI (5712.5 km), and KWP (8397.6 km).
